brief.question: What is OpenMinion and what does it provide to agent builders?
brief.summary: OpenMinion is a Python-first, local-first runtime designed for building, running, and operating tool-using AI agents locally and across environments.

findings.claim: OpenMinion is a Python-first, local-first runtime for tool-using agents that can perform real work locally and across environments.
It provides a unified local-first runtime keeping execution, tools, state, and diagnostics together.
Builders can use flexible entry points including a CLI, Python SDK, HTTP API, and daemon-backed workflows without altering the underlying execution model.
It supports multi-provider integration and provider switching across models such as OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama, and Cortensor.
It includes durable sessions, conversations, threads, runs, and OpenTelemetry readiness for diagnostics and observability.

research_draft:
researcher: OpenMinion is a Python-first, local-first runtime designed for building and running tool-using AI agents that can perform real work locally and across environments [https://www.openminion.com/].

For agent builders, OpenMinion provides several key capabilities and features:
* **Unified Local-First Runtime:** It allows builders to keep execution, tools, state, and diagnostics together in a single runtime rather than rebuilding the agent around different entry points [https://www.openminion.com/].
* **Flexible Entry Points & Workflows:** Builders can develop and deploy agents through a CLI, a released Python SDK, an HTTP API, or daemon-backed workflows without altering the underlying execution model [https://www.openminion.com/].
* **Multi-Provider & Provider Switching:** It supports integration with various model providers (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama, and Cortensor) and application patterns like provider switching and multi-provider agents [https://www.openminion.com/docs/examples/patterns/multi-provider-agents/].
* **Durable Sessions & Infrastructure:** It includes built-in support for persistent sessions, conversations, tool-using capabilities, and OpenTelemetry (OTel) readiness for diagnostics [https://www.openminion.com/].
